title: Frequently Asked Questions
snippet:
#### Is the Podio API free to use?
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API and the same base rate Limit A and Limit B apply. There is no extra charge for using the API as long as the usage is within these base rate limits. Paid accounts have an additional capability of upgrading to higher API rate limits by purchasing an API Add-on.

If your API integration requires a higher rate limit, you can request your contract owner to purchase an API Add-on for the relevant API key.

snippet:
The paid plans cost $14 to $24 per user per month, less if you pay yearly, and the Free plan stops at 5 users and 100 items.

title: Podio Pricing Guide 2026: Features And Plan Comparison
snippet:
- Podio offers three pricing tiers 'Free, Plus, and Premium' billed on a per-employee, per-month basis
- Annual billing provides a at a lower per-user rate compared to monthly billing across all paid plans
- Client users, including contractors, freelancers, and external collaborators, are free on all plans and do not count toward the per-employee cost
- Teams requiring custom integrations, larger user volumes, or enterprise-level configurations can request custom pricing directly from Podio
- All plans include unlimited workspaces, apps, granular app permissions, and basic workflow tools, with advanced features unlocked at higher tiers
Here’s how Podio features differ across plans:
| **Feature** | **Free** | **Plus** | **Premium** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workspaces | Limited workspaces | Unlimited workspaces | Unlimited workspaces |
| Users | Limited users | Scalable users | Scalable users |
| Task Management | Basic task tools | Advanced task management | Advanced + automation options |
| Workflow Automation | Limited | Available (basic automation) | Advanced automation & rules |
| Custom Apps | Limited app creation | Build custom apps | Advanced app builder tools |
| Reporting And Dashboards | Basic views | Custom dashboards | Advanced reporting |
| File Sharing | Included | Included | Included with higher storage limits |
| Integrations | Limited | Standard integrations | Extended integrations |
| User Permissions | Basic access control | Role-based permissions | Advanced permission settings |
| Admin Controls | Basic | Standard | Advanced |
| Security Features | Standard security | Standard + permissions | Enhanced security options |
| Support | Community support | Standard support | Priority support |
| Automation Limits | Limited | Higher limits | Higher limits |

### **Podio Free Plan**
**Ideal For:** Individuals, freelancers, and very small teams of up to five employees who need a no-cost introduction to structured project collaboration.
**Pricing:** $0/user/month
**What To Know About This Plan:** The Free plan provides access to Podio's core workspace and task management tools at no cost. It is designed for teams that are just getting started with digital project organization and want to evaluate the platform before committing to a paid subscription. The plan caps usage at five employee users and limits items to 100 per organization, which suits small, simple projects but can become a constraint as teams grow or project volume increases.

title: Concepts and conventions: Rate limits
snippet:
The Podio API only allows you to make a certain amount of API calls each hour. The general limit is 1,000 API calls per hour, but if the API call is deemed resource-intensive, a lower rate of 250 calls per hour is enforced. So Podio API uses a two-limit model.
- Limit A = 250 calls per hour. It applies to resource-intensive operations marked "Limit A" or "Rate-Limited" in the API reference.
- Limit B = 1,000 calls per hour. It applies to all standard API operations marked "Limit B" or "Standard" in the API reference.
If you hit the rate limits the API will begin returning 420 HTTP error codes for all API calls. Rate limits are per user per API key and are measured on a rolling hour basis.

If you have a project that requires a higher rate limit, get an API Add-on for your related API key. An API Add-on will give your key increased rate limits (both Limit A and B). We have multiple tiers available for API Add-ons, so you can choose which tier is most relevant for your anticipated usage. Read [product documentation](https://progress.com/podio/documentation/using-podio/upgrade-and-billing/what-add-ons-in-podio) to learn more about how to choose, buy and manage Add-ons.
In case your project requires a rate limit higher than the available API Add-ons, [contact us](https://progress.com/podio/documentation/welcome) with a brief description of your project, your estimated usage, and the client_id of the API key you are using to raise an exception request.

title: Podio
snippet:
Podio, a project management and collaboration product owned by Progress Software Corporation since 2021, scores highest on pricing transparency: the $0 per user per month free tier capped at up to 5 users, both billing-cycle notes, the tax exclusion, and add-on floors (API from $23/month, automation from $39/month) are public — though the record never shows the paid tiers' per-seat prices.
